details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: heap corruption on reassembly of an oversized WebSocket
     message and on sending an oversized WebSocket frame
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-102557-CVE-2026-102559.patch: cap message
       reassembly and outgoing frames at the GByteArray size limit in
       process_contents() and send_message() in
       libsoup/soup-websocket-connection.c, add tests in
       tests/websocket-test.c
     - CVE-2026-102557
     - CVE-2026-102559
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap buffer overflow on an oversized incoming WebSocket
     frame with an unlimited max-incoming-payload-size
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-102558.patch: cap incoming frame payloads at
       what the receive buffer can hold in process_frame() in
       libsoup/soup-websocket-connection.c
     - CVE-2026-102558
   * SECURITY UPDATE: infinite read loop on WebSocket input, prerequisite of
     the CVE-2026-102558 fix
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-52532.patch: process each frame as soon as
       data is read in on_web_socket_input() in
       libsoup/soup-websocket-connection.c
     - CVE-2024-52532
   * SECURITY UPDATE: type confusion in the WebSocket pong signal
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-102556.patch: emit the pong signal with a
       GBytes as declared in receive_pong() in
       libsoup/soup-websocket-connection.c
     - CVE-2026-102556
